script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The verse says the couriers travel by sea on the waters; it does not say they travel on a river.
Saying he can see horses in the baker's head assumes what the baker is imagining.
The comparison does not work: a rolling pin flattens dough rather than cutting through it.
The text does not say the banner is too far away to reach.
The LORD says He will quietly look on; that does not establish that nothing is rushing or shouting.
The explanation assumes the word woe is what made the baker think of battle. It also says quiet is the opposite of rushing, which it is not.
The text does not say both images are soft and still, or that they can be seen without hearing anything.
The explanation assumes the baker expected weapons because the nation was feared.
